name: Flute
author: Versilian Studios (samples); DAW build script
attribution: Versilian Studios VSCO-2 Community Edition (Sam Gossner / Versilian Studios), CC0 1.0
desc: Concert flute, non-vibrato sustain, 2 dynamics. Airy, pure, soaring highs. Range C4-C7 (MIDI 60-96, best G4-C7). Melodies, countermelodies, pads doubled an octave up. | Playable MIDI 60-96 (C4-C7), 2 velocity layers crossfaded. Params: human 0-1 (timing/level/pitch life), velcurve (velocity response), keytrack/bright (tone follows pitch/velocity). Legato melody: overlap consecutive notes by ~30 ms (next note starts before the previous ends) with glide 0.03-0.06; wide leaps crossfade naturally (legato=1), legato=0 = pure slide.
